messages:
Priya: Hey team — quick q for my first week. Where's the best place to ask about getting Git creds and who to ping for laptop VPN access? Also, are we supposed to use threads for everything or is it OK to DM?

Sam (onboarding): Welcome Priya! :tada: For Git creds and access requests, file a ticket in #help and tag @it. If it looks urgent (can't push, blocked on deploy) also ping @it on that ticket. Use #help for access stuff so others can search the thread later.

Maya (devex): Threads: please thread replies to keep channels tidy. Short follow-ups are fine in-channel if it's ephemeral planning, but ask/answer pairs should go in threads. Use DMs for 1:1s, not for general infra questions.

Priya: Got it — ticket in #help. What about bots? I saw an onboarding checklist bot — how do I run that?

Onboarding-Bot: @Priya I kicked off your checklist when you signed up. To re-run: `/onboard status` or `/onboard rerun`. To see missing items: `/onboard list-missing`. Example:
```
/onboard status
# => 6/12 done: ssh-key, gcloud, code-editor
```

Sam (onboarding): If the bot shows missing SSH keys, follow the doc in the wiki: https://wiki.redwood.ai/onboarding/ssh-keys — paste the public key into the ticket.

Josh: For VPN/laptop provisioning tag @it and include your ticket ID and preferred OS. If you need a loaner right away, say so and add "loaner: yes" in the ticket. Also: avoid @channel unless you're scheduling company-wide downtime. Use @here only for time-sensitive requests impacting people who are online.

IT-Bot: To request a device or VPN token, use:
```
/device-request --type "vpn-token" --user priya
```
OR open #help and type `@it create vpn request` and the bot will create a ticket.

Maya (devex): A couple of channel norms that help: 1) add a short subject line in the first message when starting a new thread, 2) use reactions for "ack" instead of posting "ack" messages, 3) use code blocks for logs/config snippets, and 4) put high-cardinality noise (e.g., CI logs) in #eng-builds not in general channels.

Priya: Perfect — will do. One last thing: where do I introduce myself?

Sam (onboarding): Drop a short intro in #general and paste the link to your intro doc in #new-hires if you want more structured replies. We usually pin intros for the week. :wave:

Priya: Thanks everyone! Going to open the #help ticket now and run `/onboard status`. :smile: 

Maya (devex): Also set your notification preferences to "mentions and direct messages" for the first few days so you don't miss important pings.

Josh: If anything blocks you, escalate to your manager and cc #oncall only if it's production-impacting. :thumbsup:

Onboarding-Bot: Ticket created: HELP-4823 by Priya. Check status at https://tickets.redwood.ai/HELP-4823

Priya: Thanks — closing the loop here. :)
